    "Add proper horizontal padding (at least 24px) to the yellow 'Poglejte ponudbo' button, center its text on mobile, and remove the underline inside the button.",
    "Increase the line-height on all display serif headings (especially 'Slaščice po receptih...' and 'Torte po naročilu, kava na stari mašini') so descenders and diacritics do not touch.",
    "Include the town name (Slovenske Konjice) in the hero or header so visitors immediately know where the bakery is located without scrolling to the footer."
